Why pay over $53,000 per parking space?
In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure announced it sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million; the buyer kept it for parking.
In 2026, the company said its sales so far averaged about a 2% cap rate on parking profit, with buyers valuing sites for development, campuses and land.
Example, at a 2% tax on full value: $2M of land costs $40,000 a year; add a $20M building and it's $440,000.
Sources: Mobile Infrastructure releases (Apr 2026), Parking Reform Network (2023), Lincoln Institute of Land Policy.
News and education, not financial advice.
